source_issues.problem: The toy source stores prompt_tokens and batches by concurrency, but neither prompt length nor computed unique_prefixes affects its timing model. Changing concurrency in the printed loop does not model saturation or concurrent decode effects. This limits the realistic-distribution/concurrency demonstration.
static_evidence: code/main.py:35-36 varies prompt_tokens, but simulate never reads that field.
code/main.py:46 computes unique_prefixes but never uses it.
code/main.py:48-52 assigns only fixed cache-hit/cache-miss TTFT, with a persistent cache over the same ordered requests.
